findings.current: A snake hiding between moss-covered rocks glared at us with bright yellow eyes, while a leopard lying flat in the grass and searching for prey spotted the White Tiger and slowly began backing away.
findings.defect: The source also establishes the dense undergrowth filling every direction and the trees towering like giants. Both images are omitted.
findings.rationale: These are explicit landscape details in the Korean source, and the accepted baseline preserved them.
findings.replacement: Dense undergrowth filled every direction, and trees stood tall like giants. A snake hiding between moss-covered rocks glared at us with bright yellow eyes, while a leopard lying flat in the grass and searching for prey spotted the White Tiger and slowly began backing away.

findings.current: I broke both arms of the men who came at me late, and the legs of those who tried to run away.
findings.defect: The assembled version omits that the interrogation proceeded quickly and smoothly and that the preparations for it were flawless.
findings.rationale: Both omitted statements are explicit in the source and were present in the accepted baseline.
findings.replacement: The interrogation proceeded quickly and smoothly. Of course, the preparations for it had also been flawless. I broke both arms of the men who came at me late, and the legs of those who tried to run away.

summary: The assembled English is largely faithful, but it omits a source image and two explicit details about the interrogation.
